result:
I found no blocking issues, only two advisories. The new paging code is correct, but on an unknown total it has no stop of its own if the server ignores `offset`. Paging order is also unstable, which is an older issue.

```
VERDICT: PASS
CANDIDATE: 9c652009a7dc958afa4aa6f3d84c4c79609b7034
FINDING unbounded-unknown-total-paging advisory: When the total is unknown (missing, non-integer, bool or negative), list_all stops only when a page has fewer than 200 rows. Nothing else stops it: no page limit and no check for repeated ids. A server or proxy that ignores `offset` and keeps returning full pages would make the loop run forever and keep using more memory. Real EspoCRM honours `offset` (Facts: paging works for Meeting, and the change has crm-load page through Email by offset), so there is no plausible path on crm-beta 10.0.12. That is why this is advisory and not the brief's blocking "can loop forever" case. scripts/crm_api.py list_all has the same weakness. | evidence: load/lib/crm_load/api.py:65-67 only returns when len(rows) < PAGE. A scratch probe server always answered with 200 rows and total -1; the probe's cap of 1000 GETs was hit and every request was a GET. | expected: In a follow-up work order, raise TransportError("list_incomplete") when a full page brings no new ids, or when a page limit is exceeded.
FINDING unordered-offset-paging advisory: The paged read sends no orderBy. If the server's default sort is not unique (Email defaults to dateSent), offset paging can skip some rows and repeat others. On the unknown-total path no count check can catch this. A skipped Email would be created again on re-run and rejected with HTTP 500 by the sf_id unique index. This is pre-existing (base had no orderBy) and the work order says "no other client behaviour changes", so it is outside this change. | evidence: api.py:55-56, the query has select/maxSize/offset/where only. scripts/crm_api.py:109 uses orderBy=id, order=asc and removes duplicate ids. | expected: In a follow-up, add orderBy=id&order=asc and remove duplicate ids in crm-load list_all.
EVIDENCE:
- HEAD check: `git -C /srv/CRM/worktrees/CRM-009-H rev-parse HEAD` = 9c652009a7dc958afa4aa6f3d84c4c79609b7034, same before and after the review. `status --porcelain` is empty, so the worktree was not changed.
- Scope: 1 commit, base..candidate. Files changed: docs/IMPORT.md, load/lib/crm_load/api.py, tests/load/fixtures.py, tests/load/test_load.py. All 4 are on the allowlist. No CI, hook, Git config, dependency, download, container or vendored-file changes.
- Secrets: gitleaks base..candidate scanned 1 commit and found no leaks. A grep of the diff for IPs, URLs, emails and password/token/secret found nothing. Test data is synthetic (fx.sid, s1-0 and so on).
- HTTP methods: the list_all diff adds no request. It still makes one GET per page through _send. The test stub `_Pages` asserts method == "GET". test_incomplete_index_fails_the_load_with_no_writes asserts that no request other than GET is made. create, update and retry (_send) are unchanged. There is still no delete.
- Known-total path: the stop condition `not rows or offset >= total` is unchanged. It now also raises list_incomplete (exit 4) when len(out) != total, which makes the path stricter, not weaker. test_known_total_unchanged confirms there is no extra read once the total is reached.
- Unknown-total path: no early stop. With total -1, None, missing, "400", 1.5 or True, it reads 200+200+7 rows at offsets 0, 200, 400. It stops on an empty page. A 250-Email load indexes every Email, makes 0 writes on re-run, and every relationship's snapshot count equals its espocrm count.
- Suites, run as uid 1002 (non-root) with `python3 -I -B` on a `git archive` copy in $TMPDIR:
  - tests/load: Ran 209, OK.
  - tests/unit (`-t tests/unit`, because `-t .` cannot import tests/unit): Ran 561, OK, 1 skipped.
- Mutation: with api.py put back to the base version, tests/load gives FAILED (failures=11, errors=1). All of these are TestUnknownListTotal cases. The candidate file was restored afterwards.
- Note: /srv/CRM/worktrees/.forge-scratch/CRM-009-H/api.fixed.py was already in the scratch directory before this review. It was not created by me and I did not use it. Bash commands run from the scratch directory failed with a sandbox (bwrap) mount error on .claude/workflows, so all commands ran from /tmp and $TMPDIR.
```
